text:
JD.com’s rapid expansion in Hong Kong could challenge the property model that has long made the city’s busiest streets and shopping centres its most valuable, analysts say.
The Chinese e-commerce giant has invested more than HK$10 billion (US$1.3 billion) in Hong Kong property over the past two years, building a network of stores, warehouses and other assets
text_zh: 分析师称，京东在香港的快速扩张可能挑战长期令香港最繁忙街道和购物中心成为最有价值资产的物业模式。这家中国电商巨头过去两年已投资逾100亿港元（13亿美元）购置香港物业，构建起门店、仓库及其他资产的网络
